findings.title: Release content-hash command is self-referential on rerun
findings.description: The Phase 5 command enumerates all files under iac except the out folder, then writes iac/release/content-hashes.json. A rerun can hash the prior content-hashes.json before overwriting it, so the claimed recomputation is not deterministic or safely reproducible.
findings.impact: Phase 5 release evidence can become stale or self-referential and fail release-manifest validation.
findings.requiredRemediation: Explicitly exclude iac/release/content-hashes.json from the hashed file set, or generate it outside the hashed tree and define the non-self-hashing rule.

findings.title: ABB-17 is absent from explicit Phase 4 implementation coverage
findings.description: The candidate claims 19/19 ABB coverage, but ABB-17 is not present in any deployable-unit or work-package abbIds. AD-010 and DR-002 reference quarantine semantics, but the Architecture Building Block itself is not explicitly mapped.
findings.impact: The 19/19 ABB traceability claim and candidate-validation PASS are not auditable.
findings.requiredRemediation: Map ABB-17 to the external-data quarantine implementation work, update traceability and validation evidence, and regenerate all affected artifacts and hashes.
